mission: New-sources plan step S2 (owner approved the plan 2026-10-19 00:34Z): a pre-cutover visibility gate so dorasuta and cardrush rows, once collected in shadow, never reach a customer before each source's RED cutover. One shared set (app.services.source_publication.PRE_CUTOVER_SOURCES, restated in the worker) is consulted by customer_price_clause, source_semantics.is_customer_price, print_series.load_source_catalogue and the worker's alert reads; an invariant test keeps both sources out of SOURCE_INSTRUMENTS, the Market Index inputs and SOURCE_SEMANTICS. No behaviour changes for yuyutei or snkrdunk; no rows exist for the new sources today. Staging only; no collector, rollout, migration, source request, price, identity, mapping, Market Value/Index methodology, secret or Railway change.

impacts.reason: Customer-visible reads (print prices and history, card latest prices, print series and analytics, market movers) drop rows of a pre-cutover source. SOURCE_SEMANTICS and SOURCE_SEMANTICS_VERSION are unchanged; is_customer_price is visibility, not index eligibility. None of these files is a yuyutei or snkrdunk collector runtime input (changed_runtime_inputs empty for both).
Worker alerts (price change, stock change, owned-card value) skip pre-cutover sources, matching the API gate.

Gate tests on every covered read and the worker alert job, the worker/API set parity, and the no-registry invariant. The generic unconfigured-source tests now use the hypothetical name mercado, since cardrush is now deliberately hidden.

resources.name: API and worker services (read filters only)

dependencies: new-sources plan on branch plan/new-sources (9b8ff76); independent of S0 (#178) and S1
impact.deployment_impact: API and worker redeploy. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. Today no dorasuta or cardrush observation exists, so every response is unchanged.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR. No data, schema or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: Any yuyutei or snkrdunk price, series, mover or alert response differs from before the merge, or the signed-out web smoke fails.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: Verify staging merge and the signed-out web smoke pass; print detail pages show the same Yuyu-Tei and SNKRDUNK series as before.
